name: Mallet pluck (xylophone / marimba)

beschreibung.text: Wooden xylophone: two triangles at +1 oct +10 st, a filter envelope for the strike, 1.9 s decay with light tremolo.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `pluck.mallet`, Welsh [B1] pp. 83–84, patches Marimba and Xylophone, tables transcribed.. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: melody (as drop), groove (as drop).
